text:
maria-g: heads up — noticed a spike in playbook runs this morning after the new onboarding webhook change. playbook_invocations_per_min jumped ~6x. :warning:
alex-k: saw that, alerted on-call. looks like duplicate events from connector retries are triggering the playbooks repeatedly.
maria-g: exactly. customers getting multiple nudges. want to propose adding a circuit-breaker at the playbook-runner level to stop cascade. idea: per-account cooldown + global throttle when error spike > threshold.
dave-l: sounds good. can we do a feature-flag rollout? prefer `crmsrv.playbook_cb_v1` with 3 phases: dry-run, soft-enforce (observability only), full-enforce.
jen-r: +1. define metrics to watch during dry-run: `playbook_invocations_per_min`, `playbook_cooldown_hits`, `webhook_retries`, `duplicate_contact_events`. add alert when `cooldown_hits` > 0.5% of invocations.
maria-g: proposing rollout schedule: today dry-run for 2h on 1% of accounts, then 24h soft-enforce on 10% if metrics look OK, then full-enforce next week. comments?
alex-k: need eng help to add header from connector so runner can identify idempotency group. recommend `X-Playbook-Run-Group: <connector-id>|<event-hash>`. low-effort.
dave-l: I'll add the header and put a small rake task to backfill recent events for testing. Also will wire the feature flag toggles in LaunchDarkly (flag key as maria suggested).
ops-bot: deploy requested by dave-l: branch `playbook/circuit-breaker` -> staging. CI passed. :robot_face:
alex-k: before prod, add a circuit-breaker kill-switch and an emergency rollback doc in #incidents. if we see unexpected false positives (nudge suppressed), we must be able to revert in <10m.
maria-g: noted. will draft rollback steps and owner. also adding safelist for high-touch accounts so playbooks skip cooldown for some enterprise customers.
jen-r: can we add a telemetry tag so we can query dry-run vs enforce? include `playbook_cb_mode: dry-run|soft|enforce` in logs. makes postmortem easier.
dave-l: done — logs and metrics will emit that tag. I'll also add a Grafana dashboard panel for `playbook_cb_mode` and threshold line.
alex-k: timeline check — dave, can you push dry-run by 17:30 PT? maria, can you monitor for 2h and post snapshots in this thread?
dave-l: aiming for 17:20 PT. quick smoke with synthetic account first.
maria-g: will monitor and paste screenshots. if we see >3 duplicate nudges for any account, we flip kill-switch.
jen-r: also ping CS triage channel and CS leads so customer-facing folks are aware of potential suppression during soft-enforce. include sample FAQ lines.
maria-g: copying a short FAQ we can reuse:
```
Q: Why did I get fewer onboarding emails?
A: We’ve temporarily throttled automated nudges to prevent duplicate messages caused by connector retries. If you need immediate outreach, reply here and we’ll escalate.
```
alex-k: thanks. small note: add DB index for last_playbook_run_at on accounts table to prevent lock amplification under throttle.
dave-l: will include migration in PR — low-risk.
ops-bot: staging deploy successful for `playbook/circuit-breaker` at 2024-06-12T17:18:03Z. CI run id: 987654.
maria-g: starting dry-run now on 1% sample. will report back at +2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex-k: appreciate it. tagging @eng-oncall who might need to assist: @dave-l, @alex-k.
maria-g: dry-run update (+30m): playbook_invocations_per_min down 10% for sampled accounts, cooldown_hits=0 (expected for dry-run). no customer complaints so far. posting metric link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc/playbook-ops
jen-r: thanks — keep monitoring. if soft-enforce goes well, CS leads will prepare communication for affected segments. :shipit:
maria-g: will post final +2h snapshot and then request soft-enforce toggle if all green.
alex-k: awesome work team.
